newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish oil pipeline fire destroys five houses.
newsitem.headline: Turkish oil pipeline fire destroys five houses.

text.p: A fire caused by a leak in an oil pipeline destroyed five houses near a refinery close to the town of Batman in southeastern Turkey on Wednesday but there were no casualties, oil officials said.
The fire started after crude oil, which had leaked from the pipeline belonging to the Turkish Petroleum company (TPAO) began collecting near neighbouring houses, the officials told Reuters.
They said a cigarette end was thought to have ignited the fuel.
The pipeline was badly corroded and oil pressure caused the pipe to burst some 20 km (12.5 miles) away from Batman, they added.
"About 4,500 barrels of oil were lost as a result of the leak. Repairs to the corroded section started immediately," an official said.
The oil was being carried to the refinery belonging to the state Tupras.
The fire was put out by civilian and military personnel.
